B.title: Proper Cohomological Descent and Constructible Hypercovers — Examples

minimality: Two requested descent IDs plus one necessary generic bicosimplicial total/diagonal lemma. The existing AW theorem applies only to singular products, so does not fill this interface. No geometric acyclicity/hypercover theorem is assumed in the proofs.

lem-bicosimplicial-derived-total-complex.claim: Natural finite-operator chain homotopy between double cosimplicial total and diagonal total, with internal lower bound a.
lem-bicosimplicial-derived-total-complex.proof: Construct universal maps/homotopies on representable Δp×Δq models using specified vertex/prism contractions; reverse finite operator identities to cosimplicial cochains; extend to internal differential with signed total.
lem-bicosimplicial-derived-total-complex.consumer_check: Derived simplicial cochain model strictifies the W_{r,j} diagram; generic bisimplicial lemma actually applies, unlike existing singular-product AW theorem.

lem-proper-surjective-maps-have-cohomolo.claim: For proper surj f and bounded constructible field F, F→Tot Rfp*fp*F is quasiiso; basechange/global versions.
lem-proper-surjective-maps-have-cohomolo.proof: ProperBC stalk rows Hq(Fx)→Hq(S,Fx)→Hq(S²,Fx)... contracted by insertion of one point y∈S, hδ+δh=id. Finite diagonal augmented-cone spectral sequence has zero horizontal homology.

lem-proper-surjective-maps-have-cohomolo.consumer_check: No individual fiber acyclicity assumed; arbitrary Hq(S) rows retained and contracted through all Cech powers; no singular comparison needed.

thm-proper-hypercovers-compute-construct.claim: Every proper hypercover computes F and ordinary RΓ; E1 Hq(Xp,ap*F) strongly converges by finite diagonal; common refinement canonical.
thm-proper-hypercovers-compute-construct.proof: Bounded-height induction: V=cosk_nU, levelwise Uk→Vk finite basechange/product of matching cover, horizontal Cech W computes V. Double total=diagonalD; U retract ofD gives descent. Infinite U agrees with cosk_NU through N; degree m requires N≥m−a+1.

thm-proper-hypercovers-compute-construct.consumer_check: Actual complete bodies of proper weights, hyperresolution geometry and nodal example read. Weights F=Q lowerbound0/n+1 skeleton and refinements fit. Nodal2-term-square inference replaced by concrete normalization-Cech E2 calculation in consumer-checks.md.

ex-proper-cech-descent-does-not-require-.statement: P1→pt is proper surjective with nonzero H2(P1,k), but its augmented Cech product total computes only k in degree0.
ex-proper-cech-descent-does-not-require-.proof: For S=P1, properCech E1 rows are Hq(S^(p+1),k). Choose a point y and use its first-coordinate insertion to obtain hδ+δh=id including augmentation. The q=2 terms are not zero (already H2(P1,k)=k); their entire augmented row is nevertheless contracted. Consequently only the augmentation k remains in the unaugmented total, illustrating precisely why individual-fiber acyclicity is not needed. The identification P1(C)≅S² is stereographic projection, including its point at infinity; the two published sphere/field-dual suppliers compute H²=k.

ex-hypercover-total-degree-uses-only-a-f.statement: For F=k and total degree n, hypercover cohomology uses only levels through n+1; for lower bound a the corresponding cutoff is n−a+1.
ex-hypercover-total-degree-uses-only-a-f.proof: Term (p,q) has p≥0,q≥a and p+q=m, so in degrees n−1,n,n+1 all p≤n−a+1. Agreement through that simplicial level gives equal chain groups and differentials in the three degrees, hence the same Hn. For F=k,a=0, the outgoing differential from a term p=n,q=0 can involve p=n+1, explaining why n+1 is retained rather than only n.
